answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake that only unlocks after a slow maturation window, like a river that cannot be rushed: a sybil farmer must lock real capital per identity for weeks, so spawning thousands of cheap copies at dawn costs more than any single job pays. Peers then treat each identity like a lantern with a visible burn history — stake size, age, and past attestations are public — and route high-value work only to identities whose stake and history exceed the job's value, making mass fake identities economically worthless.
